correctness.rationale: Exact reduction by reflection/sign symmetry preserves the objective and cannot increase the sum BL norm. The resulting 2-variable unit ball is the intersection of 16 explicit halfplanes and has exactly six rational vertices verified by pairwise intersection arithmetic. Evaluation proves the max of two branches for every real parameter t in (0,1). An independent monotone-cone derivative argument gives the restricted supremum, and endpoint flattening proves minimality on paths of at most three sites. Exact arithmetic script replayed; 98 separate full-space numerical LP values agreed without being used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This example quantitatively disproves the plausible transport heuristic that strictly positive edge fluxes force a nondecreasing Dudley-norming potential. It is sharp in path cardinality, has an exact rational crossover, and exposes the boundary between unrestricted and order-preserving dual optimizations. The evidence provides a motivated threshold rather than an arbitrary single computation; no theorem about arbitrary metrics is claimed.
